title: Best Travel Power Strip 2026: 5 strips tested for outlets, surge, and international use
description: Belkin Mini Surge, Anker 321, Addtam Flat Plug, Monster Mini, NTONPOWER International — AC outlets, USB-C/USB-A counts, surge protection, voltage compatibility.
lede: Five travel power strips tested across US, EU, and Asia trips. We measured AC outlet count, USB ports, surge protection (joules), and dual-voltage compatibility.
methodology: Each strip tested with laptop + phone + iPad + camera + smartwatch (5 devices). Surge tested via UL-rated tester. International tested in EU (220V) and UK (240V) outlets.

sections.heading: Outlets, USB-C, and surge
paragraphs: Addtam Flat Plug: 6 AC + 3 USB-A (most outlets). Anker 321: 3 AC + 2 USB-C + 1 USB-A (USB-C PD 30W for laptops). NTONPOWER: 4 AC + 4 USB + international adapter (UK/EU/AU/US).

Surge protection: Belkin Mini Surge 918 joules (highest), Monster Mini 540 joules. Anker, Addtam, NTONPOWER have no surge protection (just power strips). For laptops/expensive gear, choose surge-protected (Belkin or Monster).

faqs.q: Do I need surge protection in a hotel?
faqs.a: Yes for laptop/expensive gear in regions with unstable grids (Latin America, Southeast Asia, some Eastern Europe). For developed-country hotels, surge incidents are rare. Belkin Mini Surge at $25 is cheap insurance for $1500+ laptop.

Look for 30W+ USB-C PD output to charge modern laptops (M-series Macs need 30W min). Anker 321 has it. Most travel strips top out at 18W (phone-only PD). For laptop charging via USB-C, Anker is the only option in test.

belkin-mini-surge-3outlet.review: Best travel basics. 3 outlets + 2 USB-A, swivel plug for tight outlets. 918 joules surge protection. Compact reliable.

anker-321-power-strip.review: Best USB-C. 3 AC + 2 USB-C + 1 USB-A, 30W USB-C PD output for laptops. Flat plug, 5-ft cord.

addtam-flat-plug-strip.review: 6 outlets + 3 USB ports, ultra-thin flat plug, 5-ft braided cord. Budget pick with most outlets.

monster-mini-powercenter-travel.review: 3 outlets + 2 USB-A (2.4A), 540 joules surge. Wall-mountable, swivel plug. Compact for hotel desks.

ntonpower-international-strip.review: 4 outlets + 4 USB + international adapter (UK/EU/AU/US). Dual-voltage compatible. Best for international.
